statement: Organisations with a >= 1e26 FLOP training run are headquartered in >= 4 jurisdictions (Epoch AI; snapshot 2027-12-31)
status_at_phase_end: 0 jurisdictions at end-2023 (no organisation known to have reached 1e26 FLOP). The frontier compute tier (~1e25 FLOP class) was concentrated in a handful of Bloc A firms; Bloc B labs trailed on compute and other metrics per Epoch.

items.summary: Epoch AI: frontier-scale training compute was concentrated in three Bloc A firms (largest run ~2e25 FLOP); Bloc B industry labs lagged on compute, citations and foundation models. No organisation in any jurisdiction had a 1e26 FLOP run.
items.detail: Epoch AI, 'Who is leading in AI? An analysis of industry AI research' (late 2023; date approximate) (verified via web_extract this run). Named leaders Google, OpenAI, Meta (Bloc A); Tencent, Baidu, Huawei (Bloc B) trail.

items.summary: A Bloc A executive order treated 1e26-operation training runs as a future reporting category and required reporting of foreign customers' large training runs on domestic cloud infrastructure, signalling an intent to monitor where frontier-scale training could occur abroad.
items.detail: Bloc A Executive Order 14110, Sec. 4.2(c) (IaaS / foreign-person training-run reporting; 1e26-operation default trigger), 88 FR 75191, 2023-11-01 (verified via web_extract of the Federal Register full text this run).
